blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo praticar e contrastar not so much… as…, not… but, rather than e less… than… numa entrevista sobre terminologia, e usar weed out.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.intro: A terminologist explains how a hospital standardized its vocabulary.
qa: Interviewer: Was the project about correcting mistakes?
**Not so much** correcting **as** reconciling. Three departments used three words for the same device, **and each was defensible**.
Interviewer: How did you decide which to keep?
We looked at **frequency**, **less than** at elegance. **Rather than** impose a winner, we asked clinicians to vote, then **weeded out** the variants nobody used.
**Not** because the list was perfect **but** because people had helped write it. **More than** any glossary, ownership changed behavior.

blocks.body: Contraste: *not X but Y* **nega X** por completo; *not so much X as Y* **mantém X em segundo plano**. Mantenha o paralelismo.
*Not so much because it was perfect as because* ✓ — repita *because* nos dois lados.

items.s: We looked at frequency, ___ than at elegance. (less)
___ than impose a winner, we asked clinicians to vote. (rather)
We ___ out the variants nobody used. (weed)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Be of one mind.** — Estar de acordo.
**Come to terms with.** — Aceitar, conformar-se com.
**Iron out the wrinkles.** — Resolver os detalhes.
**Split hairs.** — Ficar em minúcias.
**Common ground.** — Terreno comum.
**Speak the same language.** — Falar a mesma língua.
**Line up with.** — Alinhar-se com.
**Tip the balance.** — Desequilibrar a favor.
**Pull in the same direction.** — Remar na mesma direção.
**Get everyone on board.** — Trazer todos a bordo.
**And the unused variants?** — E as variantes sem uso?
**Is the glossary meant to correct the departments?** — O glossário serve para corrigir os departamentos?
**Not so much correct them as reconcile them.** — Não tanto corrigi-los quanto conciliá-los.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences using not so much… as…, less… than…, not… but, rather than and weed out.
blocks.model: We changed the form not so much to save time as to save patience. The delay was less a technical failure than a failure of nerve. We acted not because we were ordered but because we were convinced. Rather than add more rules, we weeded out the old ones. It is more a habit than a policy.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
